Protection Profile for Example Devices

Version 1.0, 2026-01-15. A protection profile written for this repository's tests: its text is the repository's own.

1. Introduction

The Target of Evaluation is an example device that authenticates its administrators.

5. Security Functional Requirements

5.1 Identification and Authentication (FIA)

FIA_UAU.2 User authentication before any action

FIA_UAU.2.1 The TSF shall require each administrator to be successfully authenticated before allowing any other TSF-mediated actions on behalf of that administrator.

Appendix A - Optional Requirements

A.1 Cryptographic Support (FCS)

FCS_COP.1.1/Hash The TSF shall perform cryptographic hashing in accordance with [selection: SHA-256, SHA-384].

Appendix B - Extended Component Definitions

FIA_EXA_EXT.1.1 The TSF shall be defined here, not required here.
